_comment: C-FID: each outward fidelity claim, anchored to the G0 counters that enforce it. check-fidelity-claims.py verifies (1) every gate_id is in gates/g0-classification.json's violation set (a claim cannot cite a counter that does not gate), (2) every readme_anchor appears in the outward README (the ledger stays in sync with the surface), and (3) enforced_by exists. Changing this file is an owner decision, not a fix for a red build. Future hardening candidate: grep-match that enforced_by actually computes the cited counter (deferred; counter names may not appear as literals in g0_fidelity_gate.py, which would false-fail).

readme_anchors: 空白の畳み込みを除いて完全に一致
同じ主張を機械検証 (G0) で担保
